name: Save for a big goal
summary: Save for something big, like a trip, car or down payment, with a monthly target and cut-or-earn options to close any gap.

onboarding.reaction: Ooh, exciting. Let's give it a date.
Big numbers get small when you split them up.

onboarding.prompt: When do you want it by?
onboarding.reaction: Deadline set. We'll show the monthly number.

onboarding.prompt: Tap a time for a monthly savings check.

phases.name: Size it
benchmarks: Gap (if any) has a cut-or-earn plan
actions: Calculate monthly target from amount and deadline
Pick cut options (subscriptions, eating out) and earn options (sell items, extra shifts)

phases.name: Save
benchmarks: Monthly target met or gap plan used

phases.name: Finish
benchmarks: Goal reached or new date set

plan_blueprint.calendar: A monthly transfer reminder and check-in at the chosen slot, milestone dates, and the deadline. Phase lengths stretch or shrink with the deadline.

approach_variants.habit: Automatic monthly transfer and a streak of months on target.
approach_variants.willpower: Countdown to the deadline with a monthly cut-or-earn challenge.
approach_variants.time: Monthly transfer and review blocks; quarterly time review.
approach_variants.reward: A photo of the goal shown at each milestone, plus an owner-chosen mini reward.
approach_variants.resource: First week opens a separate savings spot and lists cut-or-earn options.

guardrails: This plan is general education, not financial advice. Check big decisions with a qualified professional.
Account numbers and log-ins are never asked for; you enter only the totals you choose.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed month spreads the shortfall across the remaining months, or offers to move the deadline. After three missed months, the plan asks whether to pause, resize or change the goal.
